content.text: PostgreSQL is the world's most advanced open-source relational database, offering extensibility, standards compliance, and enterprise-grade features for modern applications.

items: PostgreSQL Deep Dive — MVCC, advanced indexing, JSONB, partitioning, replication, and connection pooling
Replication and High Availability — Streaming replication, logical replication, Patroni, PgBouncer connection pooling, and failover strategies
Performance Tuning — EXPLAIN ANALYZE, index strategies (B-tree, GIN, GiST, BRIN), query optimization, vacuum tuning, and pg_stat_statements
Advanced Features — JSONB operations, full-text search, partitioning, CTEs, window functions, and extensions (PostGIS, pg_cron, TimescaleDB)
